title: Inorganic Chemistry Ii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only halogen oxide which is stable with respect to dissociation into elements."
I2O5 is the only halogen oxide which is stable with respect to dissociation into elements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the synthetic equivalents of hydrocarbons in which some or all of the hydrogens have been replaced by fluorine atoms, e.g."
Fluorocarbons are the synthetic equivalents of hydrocarbons in which some or all of the hydrogens have been replaced by fluorine atoms, e.g.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the major acids of modern chemical industry."
Nitric acid is one of the major acids of modern chemical industry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an amorphous form of SiO2 with a porous structure."
Silica gel is an amorphous form of SiO2 with a porous structure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most effective nematocide known."
Methyl bromide is the most effective nematocide known.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called hydrohalic acids, viz., hydrofluoric, hydrochloric, hydrobromic and hydriodic acid."
Aqueous solutions of hydrogen halides are called hydrohalic acids, viz., hydrofluoric, hydrochloric, hydrobromic and hydriodic acid.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a carbon rod impregnated with copper to render it inert and cathode is made of steel or copper."
Anode is a carbon rod impregnated with copper to render it inert and cathode is made of steel or copper.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the chief constituent of glass."
Silica is the chief constituent of glass.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most metallic of the allotropes of phosphorus and is often called metallic phosphorus."
Black phosphorus is the most metallic of the allotropes of phosphorus and is often called metallic phosphorus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major component of the earth's atmosphere."
Nitrogen is a major component of the earth's atmosphere.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most electronegative elements in their respective periods and their chemistries are essentially non-metallic."
Halogens are the most electronegative elements in their respective periods and their chemistries are essentially non-metallic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the important salts of hypochlorous acid and is used in bleaching cotton fabrics, wood pulp and also as a disinfectant."
NaOCl is one of the important salts of hypochlorous acid and is used in bleaching cotton fabrics, wood pulp and also as a disinfectant.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in glass and cement manufacture."
Silicates are used in glass and cement manufacture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used as a thermal insulator for lagging steam pipes, for making fire proof textiles and as an insulator."
Asbestos is used as a thermal insulator for lagging steam pipes, for making fire proof textiles and as an insulator.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in various forms as a fertiliser, e.g., as NH4NO3, (NH4)2SO4, (NH4)2HPO4, etc."
Ammonia is used in various forms as a fertiliser, e.g., as NH4NO3, (NH4)2SO4, (NH4)2HPO4, etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a basic solvent because it can easily accept a proton."
Liquid ammonia is a basic solvent because it can easily accept a proton.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in fertilisers, cleaning of metals, rust proofing, pharmaceuticals, etc."
Phosphoric acid is used in fertilisers, cleaning of metals, rust proofing, pharmaceuticals, etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in making semiconductors and in solar cells which are becoming increasingly important."
Very pure silicon is used in making semiconductors and in solar cells which are becoming increasingly important.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rarest of all the halogens, forming only 4.6 x 10-5% of earth's crust."
Iodine is the rarest of all the halogens, forming only 4.6 x 10-5% of earth's crust.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the oxygen currying protein in blood."
Haemoglobin is the oxygen currying protein in blood.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for aquatic weed control."
Sodium arsenite is used for aquatic weed control.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a colourless liquid (b.p. 359 K); It decomposes readily in light giving a yellow colour due to the formation of nitrogen dioxide."
Pure nitric acid is a colourless liquid (b.p. 359 K); It decomposes readily in light giving a yellow colour due to the formation of nitrogen dioxide.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the acid in which ionisable hydrogen atoms are attached to the central atom through oxygen atoms, e.g., CI-OH."
An oxoacid is the acid in which ionisable hydrogen atoms are attached to the central atom through oxygen atoms, e.g., CI-OH.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in tooth pastes as a source of fluoride ions to harden dental enamel."
Stannous fluoride is used in tooth pastes as a source of fluoride ions to harden dental enamel.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second most abundant element in the earth's crust forming about 27.7%."
Silicon is the second most abundant element in the earth's crust forming about 27.7%.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a colourless gas with a faint smell."
CO2 is a colourless gas with a faint smell.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in jewellery on account of their high refractive and dispersive power."
Diamonds are used in jewellery on account of their high refractive and dispersive power.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the purest materials used in the production of transistors."
Hyperfine Si is one of the purest materials used in the production of transistors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the other important oxide of carbon."
Carbon dioxide is the other important oxide of carbon.
fib: ______ is used as a wood preservative.
Arsenic acid
Arsenic acid is used as a wood preservative.
______ is the eleventh element in order of abundance in the crustal rocks of the earth, its occurrence being to the extent of 0.112%.
Phosphorus
Phosphorus is the eleventh element in order of abundance in the crustal rocks of the earth, its occurrence being to the extent of 0.112%.
______ are used in baking powders and tooth-pastes.
Calcium phosphates
Calcium phosphates are used in baking powders and tooth-pastes.
______ is used as an inert material, e.g., for building roofs, and for cable sheathing.
Lead
Lead is used as an inert material, e.g., for building roofs, and for cable sheathing.
______ is a property by virtue of which elements form long chain compounds by single or multiple bond formation between atoms of the same element.
Catenation
Catenation is a property by virtue of which elements form long chain compounds by single or multiple bond formation between atoms of the same element.
______ is used as a neutron moderator in nuclear reactors.
Very pure graphite
Very pure graphite is used as a neutron moderator in nuclear reactors.
______ is a mixture of two or more liquids that distils at a certain temperature and has a constant composition at a given pressure.
Constant boiling mixture or azeotrope
Constant boiling mixture or azeotrope is a mixture of two or more liquids that distils at a certain temperature and has a constant composition at a given pressure.
______ is a nonmetal; silicon and germanium are semi-metals; tin and lead are distinctly metallic in nature.
Carbon
Carbon is a nonmetal; silicon and germanium are semi-metals; tin and lead are distinctly metallic in nature.
______ is the first element of this group; it constitutes nearly 0.054% of earth's crust, where it occurs as fluorspar (CaF2), cryolite (AlF3·3NaF) and fluorapatite [CaF2-3Ca3(PO4)2].
Fluorine
Fluorine is the first element of this group; it constitutes nearly 0.054% of earth's crust, where it occurs as fluorspar (CaF2), cryolite (AlF3·3NaF) and fluorapatite [CaF2-3Ca3(PO4)2].
______ is a gas at normal temperature, b.p. 284 K.
Chlorine dioxide
Chlorine dioxide is a gas at normal temperature, b.p. 284 K.
______ is a strong reducing agent, Sn(IF) is a mild reducing agent and Pb(II) is not a reducing agent.
Ge (Il)
Ge
Ge (Il) is a strong reducing agent, Sn(IF) is a mild reducing agent and Pb(II) is not a reducing agent.
______ is used widely as an insecticide.
Dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT)
Dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane
DDT
Dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT) is used widely as an insecticide.
______ is used as a mild reducing agent.
Stannous chloride
Stannous chloride is used as a mild reducing agent.
______ is a colourless, extremely poisonous gas having a faint garlic odour.
Phosphine
Phosphine is a colourless, extremely poisonous gas having a faint garlic odour.
______ is used to strengthen rubber, as a pigment in inks, paints, paper and plastics.
Carbon black
Carbon black is used to strengthen rubber, as a pigment in inks, paints, paper and plastics.
______ is used for disinfection of water on a large scale.
Bleaching powder or liquid chlorine
Bleaching powder or liquid chlorine is used for disinfection of water on a large scale.
______ are used in the extraction of aluminium.
Graphite electrodes
Graphite electrodes are used in the extraction of aluminium.
______ are used for making laboratory and kitchen ware.
Borate glasses like Borosil
Borate glasses like Borosil are used for making laboratory and kitchen ware.
______ is an impure form of silica.
Common sand
Common sand is an impure form of silica.
______ is used largely in transistor technology.
Germanium
Germanium is used largely in transistor technology.
______ is the purest and the most stable form of silica.
Quartz
Quartz is the purest and the most stable form of silica.
______ are a group of organosilicon polymers.
Silicones
Silicones are a group of organosilicon polymers.
______ is a form of luminescence in which a substance emits light of one wavelength after having absorbed electromagnetic radiation of shorter wavelength.
Phosphorescence
Phosphorescence is a form of luminescence in which a substance emits light of one wavelength after having absorbed electromagnetic radiation of shorter wavelength.
______ are known for every positive oxidation state of nitrogen from +1 to +5.
Oxides of nitrogen
Oxides of nitrogen are known for every positive oxidation state of nitrogen from +1 to +5.
______ is used in matches, fire works and as a component of phosphor-bronze alloys used for making bearings.
Red phosphorus
Red phosphorus is used in matches, fire works and as a component of phosphor-bronze alloys used for making bearings.
______ is a very important industry and it plays an important role in national economy.
Silicate industry
Silicate industry is a very important industry and it plays an important role in national economy.
______ is the number of oxygen atoms attached to the halogen, more effective is the displacement of shared electrons towards the terminal oxygen atoms and more acidic is the oxoacid.
higher
higher is the number of oxygen atoms attached to the halogen, more effective is the displacement of shared electrons towards the terminal oxygen atoms and more acidic is the oxoacid.
______ is the material used in a nuclear reactor to moderate or slow down neutrons from the high velocities tit which they are created in the fission process.
Moderator
Moderator is the material used in a nuclear reactor to moderate or slow down neutrons from the high velocities tit which they are created in the fission process.
